title: Equazione del pendolo
promptHtml: Per il pendolo semplice T = m*l**2*th'**2/2 e V = -m*g*l*cos(th). Calcola con SymPy l'espressione di Lagrange eq = d/dt(∂L/∂θ̇) − ∂L/∂θ (con L = T − V) e mettila semplificata in eq.
starter:
import sympy as sp
t = sp.symbols("t")
m, l, g = sp.symbols("m l g", positive=True)
th = sp.Function("theta")(t)
T = m * l**2 * th.diff(t)**2 / 2
V = -m * g * l * sp.cos(th)
eq = ...
print(eq)
tests:
import sympy as sp
t_ = sp.symbols("t")
m_, l_, g_ = sp.symbols("m l g", positive=True)
th_ = sp.Function("theta")(t_)
atteso = m_ * l_**2 * th_.diff(t_, 2) + m_ * g_ * l_ * sp.sin(th_)
assert sp.simplify(eq - atteso) == 0, f"atteso m·l²·θ'' + m·g·l·sin θ, ottenuto {eq}"
solution:
import sympy as sp
t = sp.symbols("t")
m, l, g = sp.symbols("m l g", positive=True)
th = sp.Function("theta")(t)
T = m * l**2 * th.diff(t)**2 / 2
V = -m * g * l * sp.cos(th)
Lag = T - V
eq = sp.simplify(sp.diff(Lag.diff(th.diff(t)), t) - Lag.diff(th))
print(eq)
